name: Hakoiri Musume
source:
Believe it or not, our protagonist is actually bored of his over fun loving girlfriend. A new transfer student, Nishizaki Satomi, seems just what he needs: a fresh love. She turned out to be a poor rich girl raised in her home not knowing anything about the real world. He can take advantage of that or try to help her.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
难以置信的是，主人公竟然已经厌倦了过分贪玩的女友。新来的转学生西崎里美似乎正是他需要的新鲜恋情。她原来是个可怜的富家女孩，从小足不出户，对真实世界一无所知。他可以利用这一点，也可以设法帮助她。

[编辑自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
